Network Service Group Resource Delete Custom Netowrk Service Group
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/networkServiceGroups/:serviceGroupId

Deletes the network service group for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
serviceGroupId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the network service group.

Responses
​
default

Successful Operation
